mapper.insert: INSERT INTO permissions ( permission_name, permission_code, permission_desc, permission_type, parent_permission, component_path, status, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time, is_del ) VALUES ( #{permissionName}, #{permissionCode}, #{permissionDesc}, #{permissionType}, #{parentPermission}, #{componentPath}, #{status}, #{createBy}, now(), #{updateBy}, now(), false )
mapper.select:
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM permissions WHERE is_del = false
AND (permission_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR permission_code LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))
mapper.update: UPDATE permissions SET permission_name = #{permissionName}, permission_code = #{permissionCode}, permission_desc = #{permissionDesc}, permission_type = #{permissionType}, parent_permission = #{parentPermission}, component_path = #{componentPath}, status = #{status}, update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = now() WHERE uuid = CAST(#{uuid} AS uuid) AND is_del = false
UPDATE permissions SET is_del = true, update_time = now() WHERE uuid = CAST(#{uuid} AS uuid) AND is_del = false
mapper.select: SELECT id, uuid, permission_name, permission_code, permission_desc, permission_type, parent_permission, component_path, status, create_time FROM permissions WHERE is_del = false ORDER BY create_time ASC

SELECT p.uuid, p.permission_code AS permissionCode, p.permission_name AS permissionName, p.permission_type AS permissionType, p.component_path AS componentPath, p.parent_uuid AS parentPermission FROM permissions p INNER JOIN role_permis rp ON rp.permission_uuid = p.uuid INNER JOIN user_roles ur ON ur.role_code = (SELECT role_code FROM roles WHERE id = rp.role_id) WHERE ur.user_uuid = CAST(#{userUuid} AS uuid) AND p.is_del = false ORDER BY p.create_time ASC
SELECT CAST(p.uuid AS varchar) FROM permissions p INNER JOIN role_permis rp ON rp.permission_uuid = p.uuid WHERE rp.role_id = #{roleId} AND p.is_del = false
